purpose: research factor control; not individual stock prices or executable portfolio
source_header:
This file was created by using the 202607 CRSP database.
The Tbill return is the simple daily rate that, over the number of trading days
compounds to 1-month TBill rate. The 1-month TBill rate data until 202405 are from Ibbotson Associates. Starting from 202406, the 1-month TBill rate is from ICE
